QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`:2196`) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (`:2185`) are also commented out. `check_config.h:995-1009` makes both require `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`. Every lock in the tree sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C, as the macro every lock sits behind, and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as a threading macro that depends on it.
